sources.title: Muse Glimmer 30B Benchmarks & Context (August 2026) | BenchLM.ai
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer 30B is a open weight model with a 131K context window. It uses an explicit reasoning mode, which can improve complex problem solving while adding latency and token use. Meta publishes the full-precision and two 4-bit Muse Glimmer 30B checkpoints under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face.

sources.title: Meta: Muse Glimmer 30B - AI Model Details & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Meta: Muse Glimmer 30B, a dense, open-weight multimodal model, demonstrates a balanced performance profile with notable strengths in reliability and specific accuracy benchmarks. It exhibits moderate speed performance, ranking in the 34th percentile, and offers moderate pricing, positioned in the 33rd percentile across six benchmarks.
